282958798.description:
Raw Selenite Crystal Specimen
Natural Satin Spar Gypsum Bar
Earth Science & Mineral Specimen
This natural raw selenite crystal specimen showcases the characteristic parallel fibrous structure and pearlescent chatoyant sheen of satin spar gypsum. The elongated tabular formation displays distinct linear striations running longitudinally along the crystal face, accompanied by naturally cleaved ends and authentic matrix rock inclusions. Ideal as a geological study piece, display rock, or altar meditation stone.
Natural satin spar selenite gypsum mineral specimen
Characteristic fibrous crystal growth showing silky chatoyant luster
Untreated rough bar formation with natural cleavage planes and minor matrix inclusions
Measures approximately 5.75 inches long, 2 inches wide, 1.5 inches high; weighs 1.5 lbs
Condition:
Good natural specimen condition. Structurally solid formation with raw cleaved terminations. Typical geological surface roughness, natural fiber cleavage, and minor adhered matrix material present as shown.
